logo.description: Clean modern wordmark. Use white on dark backgrounds, dark purple on light backgrounds.

visual_style.mood: Premium but accessible. High-energy for dance/party ads. Calm and immersive for wellness/breathwork ads.
visual_style.photography_style: Real people wearing headphones in beautiful settings — beaches, retreats, festivals, yoga studios, outdoor ceremonies
visual_style.led_colors: Headphones have RGB LEDs (Red, Green, Blue) that glow in the dark — this is a signature visual element
key_imagery: Groups wearing glowing headphones outdoors at sunset

voice.tone: Direct, confident, slightly irreverent. Not corporate. Speaks like a founder who actually runs events, not a marketing department.
do: Use specific numbers and proof points
Lead with the experience, not the product specs
Reference real events and real clients
Speak to the transformation (not just the equipment)
dont: Oversell — let the product and proof speak
